# concealer

> Local-only, single-file secret manager for the AI-coding era. Encrypted with SOPS + age. No cloud, no telemetry, no account. AI agents use secrets (API keys, tokens, DB passwords) via CLI, Web UI, TUI, or an MCP server — without ever seeing the plaintext values. MIT-licensed, open source.

## Docs
- [Getting Started](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/getting-started.html): Install and store your first secret.
- [Installation](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/installation.html): macOS, Linux, Windows, Chrome extension.
- [Concepts](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/concepts.html): The single-file, local-only model (SOPS + age).
- [CLI Reference](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/cli-reference.html): Every command and parameter (`cer` = `concealer`).
- [Secret Types](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/secret-types.html): Single-value and multi-field secrets, scopes.
- [MCP for AI Agents](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/mcp.html): How agents inject secrets without reading them.
- [Web UI](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/web-ui.html): Searchable, scoped secret management.
- [TUI](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/tui.html): Terminal secret browser.
- [Security Model](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/security.html): Threat model and guarantees.
- [Portability & Backup](https://concealer.fxerkan.com/portability.html): Move and back up the encrypted vault.
